hypothesis: Separate exact-player current-team current-season opportunity from positional efficiency shrinkage may improve projection error relative to current raw means and deployed distributions.
features: completed REG appearances with exact player/team/game and receipt times; QB passing uses verified starts only
prior_training: aggregate demand/efficiency priors from supplied earlier training rows only; artifact cutoff precedes forecast; no paid providers or raw private archives

regularization.interpretation: Frozen sensitivity strengths, not fitted performance claims. Stored in supplied training artifact; never substituted when artifact absent.

split.locked_retrospective: 2024-2025 reused datasets, not an untouched promotion holdout
split.prospective: 2026 Week 6+ sealed before kickoff; no post-outcome tuning

acceptance: Require current-team history >=2 complete appearances and explicit feature/receipt support; no older player form fallback.
Report MAE/RMSE/bias per market and position on identical eligible samples, clustered paired intervals by game/player and coverage exclusions.
Claim accuracy improvement only if locked/prospective evidence supports it with uncertainty; no event probabilities without separately validated residual distribution.
Never equate score projections, demand shrinkage or sample count with calibrated win confidence; pushes/voids and real matched lines required for probability/market claims.
Reject malformed or contradictory identity, duplicates, missing feature rows, unknown participant, stale/missing receipts and future outcomes.
reproduction_limit: Current public profile.games lacks per-appearance team/ID/available_at receipt. Strict demonstration withholds rather than fabricates those fields.
